title: Intrinsic Spectral Cosmology
summary: We propose an intrinsic spectral cosmology based on intrinsic geometric wave mechanics, spectral dynamics, localized resonances, HJ source flow, and Hamilton--Jacobi gravity for point masses. The intrinsic field is represented through its time-local spectrum \(P(\mathbf k,t)\), whose second moment defines \(M_2\), an intrinsic scale \(R_I=M_2^{-1/2}\), and \(H_I=\dot R_I/R_I=-\dot M_2/(2M_2)\).
